brief:
The Israeli military said Sunday it killed the director of a Turkish NGO in a Gaza strike, accusing him of membership in Hamas's armed wing, Middle East Eye reported. The military did not immediately identify the individual or provide details of the operation.

Israel also said it carried out a separate strike that killed a Hamas commander, though further details were not disclosed in the initial statement.
dek: Israel says it killed head of Turkish NGO, Hamas commander in separate Gaza strikes The Israeli military said on Sunday that it had killed the director of a Turkish NGO in a strike, accusing him of being a member of Hamas's armed wing.
title: Israel claims killing Turkish NGO director in Gaza strike
